landing.headline: Know what you really earn.
landing.tagline: PayProof tells you what you really earn per hour, from screenshots you already have.
landing.simulatedNote: These screenshots are simulated examples from a fictional app, not a real platform or a real worker's data.
landing.howItWorks1: Upload a trip or weekly payout screenshot
landing.howItWorks2: Check the numbers against your own screenshot
landing.howItWorks3: See your real net pay per hour, instantly
landing.privacyNote: Your screenshots are not stored. We only keep the numbers you confirm.
upload.noFileChosen: Please choose at least one screenshot.
upload.modeMismatch: This screenshot doesn't match the type you're already reviewing (trip vs weekly). It was skipped.
review.title: Check these numbers against your screenshot
review.tapToEnlarge: Tap the screenshot to see it full size
review.needsReviewBanner: This screenshot may be unreadable: check every number against your screenshot.
review.rejectedInBatch: Some screenshots were not usable and were skipped:
review.kmDrivenWhy: Used to work out your cost per kilometre.
review.hoursOnlineWhy: Used to work out your net pay per hour online.
review.mustConfirmAll: Please confirm every highlighted field before continuing.
review.blankFieldHint: Not readable from your screenshot — type the value from your screenshot.
review.reconciliationWarning: The earning lines add up to {computed}, but your screenshot says {credited} was credited. Some lines may be missing or cut off, so your pay may be higher than shown.
review.tripReconciliationWarning: These amounts add up to {computed}, but your screenshot says {credited} was paid. Check the incentive, tip and deductions.
nav.brandHomeLabel: PayProof -- go to the first screen
nav.leaveConfirm: Leave this screen? Your changes here are not saved yet.
results.title: Your real pay
results.whyTheyDiffer: "Per hour on trips" only counts time actually driving a trip. "Per hour online" also counts time waiting for an order, so it's usually lower.
results.perHourOnTripsUnavailableNote: Weekly screenshots don't show per-trip minutes, so this rate isn't available in weekly mode.
results.deductionShare: Share of earnings taken as platform deductions
results.noLoggedInHours: You didn't enter hours online, so "per hour online" isn't shown.
results.reconciliationNote: Your earning lines do not add up to the credited total: net earnings may be understated by about {gap}.
results.tripReconciliationNoteOne: 1 trip does not add up to the total payout shown in its screenshot, so these figures may be off.
results.tripReconciliationNoteMany: {count} trips do not add up to the total payout shown in their screenshots, so these figures may be off.

ask.verified: Verified — every number comes from your confirmed data
ask.suggestionsTrip.1: What was my net pay per hour?
ask.suggestionsTrip.2: How much did I spend on fuel and maintenance?
ask.suggestionsTrip.3: What is my pay per kilometre?

ask.suggestionsWeekly.2: How much were my deductions this week?
ask.suggestionsWeekly.3: What is my pay per kilometre?
evidence.title: Evidence pack and delete
evidence.privacyNote: The evidence pack is built only from the screenshots you confirmed. It is not stored anywhere except in the page it opens.
evidence.deleteExplain: This removes every trip, weekly summary, cost and answer PayProof has stored for you. It cannot be undone.
evidence.deleteConfirmText: Are you sure? This will permanently delete all your PayProof data.

rejected.genericReason: This doesn't look like a trip or payout screenshot.
costs.title: Your costs
costs.fixedDailyWhy: Any daily cost you pay regardless of how much you drive, such as a vehicle rental.
costs.hoursOnlineWhy: Time you were logged in, including waiting for an order — not just time spent driving a trip.
